title.zh: 应用地图：材料和结构决定平台
title.en: Application map: materials and structures determine the platform

subtitle.en: Si / Conductor, Dielectric / HAR, Compound, DRIE and PECVD

body.zh: 常见 ≠ 专属；两类平台都有交叉覆盖
body.en: Common ≠ exclusive; The two platforms have overlapping coverage

body.zh: 低压力下维持较高电离程度
body.en: Maintains relatively high ionization at low pressure
Source and Bias roles can be allocated

body.zh: 适合强调方向性和反应物种控制的窗口
body.en: Suited to windows emphasizing directionality and reactive-species Control

body.zh: 设备复杂度与Chamber State也要管理
body.en: Equipment complexity and Chamber State Also require management

body.zh: 双频/多频可扩展工艺自由度
body.en: Dual / multiple frequencies expand process flexibility
Mature in Dielectric and PECVD Applications
Sheaths, frequency coupling and Charging require management

body.zh: 边界：两类反应器都能处理多种材料；具体选择取决于设备设计、配方、结构和产品CTQ。
body.en: Boundary: both reactor types can process many materials; the choice depends on equipment design, recipe, structure and product CTQ.
